fixed: Danica's Elemental Burst cooldown starts 0.4 s into the cast, as in the game, so her Bursts are 18.4 s apart in a written rotation.
Anastasya's Lament for the Lost adds 1 Polestar Field stack instead of 2, as in the latest beta.

improved: KQM Theorycrafting generates builds about 30% faster.
fixed: Phones: the character picker's Done button no longer hides under Android Chrome's bottom bar, and it sits beside the pick count.

improved: KQM builds now use 10/10/10 talents by default, as the current KQM Standards do. If you pick 9/9/9 instead, new teams start with your last pick.

Phones: every team tab is in view (Team optimize and KQM were off-screen), Feedback moved into the menu and footer so nothing covers the Optimize team button, "Use this rotation" stays at the bottom of the screen, and attack lists stay folded after you apply a written rotation.

Phones: the character picker shows each pick's team order and no longer opens the keyboard, timelines show avatars so the chart has more room, ER targets are no longer cut off, and the home page shows your inventory as compact tiles.
fixed: Team optimize: the Optimize team button stays usable when every member is switched off, so you can turn them back on (it used to lock).
Team optimize says when every member is on a TC build, and warns when a member has no artifacts to choose from.
The rotation summary shows waits as written (W1f), not as long decimals.

new: The KQM tab is now three clear steps: 1 Rotation, 2 Setup and 3 Team builds, with the team's builds raised as the result.
Damage share beside Top builds: each member's share of the team's damage, and the damage by element.

The rotation timeline under the KQM results, played with the builds shown. Click an attack to see its damage and the buffs during it; an action with several hits (Mitya's Gradient Detonation) lists them as tabs, most damage first.
Pin a moment on the timeline to see each member's stats then and what every buff gives at that moment ("Elemental Burst +400 ATK"), with the time it has left.
An empty rotation now starts with a choice: write the rotation, or add attacks yourself (or import one).
Rotations can swap a member in and straight out: write "Danica" (or "Danica entry") on its own to play just her Entry Skill, and the rotation says why when no Entry happens.
improved: KQM builds now assume C2 for standard 5★ characters (Jean, Diluc, Mona, Keqing, Qiqi, Tighnari, Dehya, Mizuki) and C1 for the 5★ characters in the free constellation event; other 5★ stay at C0 and 4★ at C6. Each can still be changed in Setup.
Top builds show only what changes from the best build, or every member's gear with the All gear switch.
The run summary above the results is shorter: weapons and artifact sets read Default or Custom, and the ER target Auto-calculated or Custom.

An attack's buffs read as where they come from and what they give ("Elemental Skill −30% Electro RES"), with the condition in the tooltip. Effects the hit doesn't use are faded, buffs with no effect are folded into one list, and the enemy's aura when the hit lands is shown.
A buff that only counts together with another is listed once, on the one that gives the effect, with the other's setting on it.
The detailed timeline has a full-screen button, and clicking a bar there pins its moment instead of closing the window.
The On field setting shows only when attacks were added by hand: a written rotation already says who is on the field for each attack.

new: Share → Constellations: compare each member's constellations by team DPS and their own DPS. Write another rotation for a constellation that plays differently (it carries to the higher ones), then make every member's chart with one click.

Constellation investment, the Team tab of the Constellations picture: the team's best constellations at each cost, counting copies (a 5★ is 1 at C0, each constellation 1 more). Rotations for combinations of constellations can be set under Advanced.

The ER calculator, redone: members as tabs, every setting in clear sections, a bar showing where each member's energy comes from against what its Bursts cost, its own Thunderous Symphony or Kablam count, and a tip for each character.
KQM Setup: choose the artifact standard: KQM Standards' 20 distributed rolls, or 25, 30, 40 or a custom number for better-farmed builds. The setup, the run summary and each build show it.
A Feedback button at the bottom right: report a bug or share an idea, with screenshots (add, drop or paste them).
improved: Rotation timeline: a scrollbar you can see, one pin shared with the detailed view, Escape to unpin, a legend for the buffs, and a detailed view that no longer jumps while you scrub.
Share: the team card shows the team as you picked it (another weapon or sets, a top team), and the charts' character art stands beside the bars, sized and centred for the list.
Sandrone's Charged Attack fires 3 beams at every constellation unless the rotation says otherwise (CA[beams=6] from C1), so a rotation plays the same at C1.
The ER calculator counts per rotation as the KQM run plays it (the written rotation's own length).
fixed: Weapon groups with several refinements ticked (R1 + R5) build at the group's usual refinement (Battle Pass R1, 4★ standard wish R5) and show the others as compared rows; the weapon chart's 100% is at that refinement.

ER calculator: the written rotation fills Skill uses and options correctly for more characters (Kazuha, Arlecchino, Cyno, Wanderer, Xilonen, Tartaglia, Amber, Alhaitham, Wriothesley and others), counts Ineffa's C4 Energy and fills in Exaiphanes Blade's triggers.
Thrilling Tales of Dragon Slayers: with a written rotation, only the wielder's switch-outs give its ATK (once every 20 s, to the member who comes in).
Flins: the rotation says when an E comes after Manifest Flame has ended (it starts it again and the next Q is a full Burst). Two Thunderous Symphonies fit at C0, three from C1.
Anastasya's and Danica's talent and constellation icons are the game's own.

new: Share your KQM results as pictures for Discord, Reddit or X (the Share button above the results): a theorycrafting team card with each member's weapon, sets, damage share, field time and Energy Recharge and the rotation, and weapon and artifact set charts for each member, measured against the best weapon from the default list. Every picture notes the version and the date, and pictures with beta characters, weapons or sets are marked as beta.

Weapon groups can count several refinements at once, for example R1 and R5: builds use the highest, and the rankings and weapon charts show each weapon at the others too. Favonius, Sacrificial and the other 4★ standard wish weapons now have their own group (R5 by default).
improved: "Opener counted" sits beside the rotation count in the KQM run settings: the same switch as the writer's "Counted" for First rotation only.

new: Anastasya C6: her Honor strike (Doom's third attack at 250%, with every member's Accolades) is used by tapping her Skill while the others are still Sealed, with no cooldown, so write it right after her Burst: "hE Q E N5D N5D E E E".
You can stop Anastasya's Doom after two stages and swap: the next rotation starts with her hold Skill again.
fixed: Anastasya: one Blessed Spear N5 string ends the others' Sealing, leaving the field ends the Blessing of Honor and Doom, and a hold Skill ends the Blessing of Love, as in the game.

Danica: her Skill ends her Maid form and her Burst's buff window, as in the game; use her Skill before swapping back in for her Burst to keep Royal Guard. A Burst cast first now also enhances a later Will to Purge, its DMG bonus multiplies the base DMG, and her C2 Toast counts once.
ER calculator: Danica's C1 and C4 Energy is counted from the written rotation.
Mitya: his C4 strike gets C6's 115% with a Steady core and counts Beacons across Skills; his detonation and hold Skill no longer count Beacons the game doesn't give.
Odette: her C6 self Elevation needs her Dance Double out, Snow Swan's Dream starts when her Burst is cast, and the Double's Stellar moves last until it leaves.

Danica and the Tsaritsa follow the 7.3 beta (7.2.52) kit changes: the Tsaritsa ascends with CRIT DMG (38.4% at 90) instead of CRIT Rate, has higher Blessed Spear and Palestar Edict: Doom Stellar Glimmer multipliers, an 18s Burst cooldown, 10% Stellar Swirl base coefficient (A4), 50% Love Stellar Glimmer CRIT DMG (C2), 200% C6 Triumph and 250% C6 Doom multipliers, and keeps C6 Honor's 20% Elevation after teammates unseal.

Danica's Maid: Royal Guard burst ATK buff is 10% up to 400 at Lv10 (18s Burst cooldown, 16s Will to Protect cooldown), C1 Royal Guard burst boost is 100%, C2 is reworked (10 Let Us Toast stacks at 80% ATK, up to 2 at 350% ATK in Maid: Cleaner, and a once-per-combat 150% Cleaning Decree Will to Purge hit), and C6 grants 15% Stellar-Conduct Elevation.

new: Weapons now follow your written rotation: for 4★ and 5★ weapons, timed buffs, stacks, their cooldowns and weapon damage procs (Skyward, Prototype, The Flute, Kagotsurube Isshin and more) count from the hits and actions that trigger them.

Weapons that react to healing (Song of Stillness, Tidal Shadow, Dialogues of the Desert Sages and others) now count heals from Diona, Qiqi, Yaoyao, Charlotte, Chevreuse, Sayu and Iansan, and heals by Max HP % (Gaming, Furina, Neuvillette, Wriothesley, Lyney).

ER calculator: Energy from Amenoma Kageuchi, Everlasting Moonglow, Kitain Cross Spear, Katsuragikiri Nagamasa, Frostbreath and other energy weapons is counted from the written rotation, and Favonius below R5 procs less often, as in the game.
The rotation writer reads KQM's Mavuika notation: C3 holds her Flamestrider Charged Attack for 3 spins and F waits for its finisher, as in "C3FD C3FD CF".
fixed: Navia's Verdict gets its Seals from the Crystallize shards she and Gorou pull in.
A Thousand Blazing Suns' Nightsoul boost counts for the wielder's hits during Nightsoul's Blessing, and the Ring Mavuika leaves when she swaps out keeps hitting.
Frostbreath's ATK buff lasts only as its wielder's Cryo- and Hydro-related reactions keep it up.
The Unforged, Summit Shaper, Memory of Dust and Vortex Vanquisher build their Golden Majesty stacks from the wielder's hits instead of always counting 5.
Attacks that take their stats when cast (Xiao's Skill, Zhongli's Stone Stele and others) now count weapon and set buffs that were up at the cast.
Amos' Bow gives Ganyu's Frostflake Bloom its 4 stacks for the arrow's flight.
Tulaytullah's Remembrance, Song of Broken Pines and Cashflow Supervision speed up Normal Attacks in the rotation.

KQM: weapon buffs a rotation can't show (Talking Stick, Wine and Song, Prospector's Drill and others) are no longer counted by default, and weapons such as Mistsplitter Reforged, Azurelight and Haran Geppaku Futsu count only what the member's attacks can give.

new: KQM: the ER targets from the ER calculator now apply by themselves when you use or change the rotation; there's no need to open Calculate ER and press Apply. Targets you type by hand stay until the rotation changes.
ER calculator: the random Energy from each member's Normal and Charged Attack hits is now counted from your written rotation (in Bonus energy).
fixed: The rotation's steps on the page keep each name and its actions on one line; on Windows the actions sat slightly higher than the names.

new: The rotation writer is wider and split into clear sections: the rotation, its time and timeline, and hits per rotation.
The Rotations setting (Repeating, or the first 1–6 from the start) is now on the page beside the rotation; changing it updates the rotation in use.
fixed: KQM tab: teams with Flins no longer crash with "Unexpected Error Occurred" when the ER targets come from the calculator.

new: Rotation writer: choose whether to count the repeating pace or only the first 1 to 6 rotations from the start, with every cooldown ready (as in a timed challenge's first rotation). Team optimize and the KQM tab use the same choice.
fixed: KQM tab: builds can now pair two sets with the same 2-piece bonus, such as Gladiator's Finale + Shimenawa's Reminiscence (ATK) or Wanderer's Troupe + Gilded Dreams (Elemental Mastery).
A rotation that opens by waiting for a cooldown now shows the wait at its end instead of its start.
Mitya: when his second tap E comes too late to switch his Detection Core, the writer says it is a new Skill and why it waits.
The rotation writer's button is now called "Write rotation".

Rotation writer: ping now sets the swap time instead of delaying every action. A swap waits for the server, so it takes about twice your ping (100 ms is 12 frames, the KQM standard), and attacks, Skills and Bursts keep their own timing.
The Human timing preset is gone: type your ping instead, or use the KQM standard button to go back to 12 frames.

ER calculator: Flins' particles now come from his Manifest Flame normal attacks (one every 2 s), Thunderous Symphony counts as its own 30-Energy Burst next to his 80-Energy one, and his C1 gives 8 Energy on the party's Lunar-Charged.
ER calculator: a Burst cadence you set by hand no longer counts Thunderous Symphony or Volcanic Kablam on top of it.
Prototype Amber's Energy now counts once per Burst of its wielder.
KQM tab: Deathmatch now counts a single opponent (ATK +24% at R1) instead of the bonus for two or more.

new: The KQM ER calculator now fills in each member's field time, skill uses, Burst cadence, particle catcher and Electro resonance from your written rotation; anything you change yourself stays, and "Use rotation" brings the rotation's values back.
Timeline: weapon and set effects that last the whole rotation now show as gold lines and are named at each moment, instead of only inside "Always on".
fixed: Long written rotations no longer lose attacks past the 40th per member, which cut their damage (for example Emilie's Burning and Lumidouce Case hits). Use your written rotation again to update a saved team.
Clash of Kings' ATK and Elemental Mastery bonus now lasts 6 s after the wielder's Skill (once every 12 s), and a Charged Attack hit while it's up adds 6 s once; it was counted for the whole rotation.
KQM tab: the timeline shows the set effects KQM counts by rule (such as Disenchantment in Deep Shadow), and buff lists no longer show sets a build doesn't wear.
Sandrone's Charged Attack after a pause now includes its wind-up, so rotations with waits are timed correctly.
Varesa's plunges now deal their falling hit.
ER calculator: Durin's Skill counts the Energy it restores, Varesa's Volcanic Kablam counts as her 30-Energy short Burst, and Sandrone starts at 5 particles and 5 bonus Energy.
The rotation's wait note now says when it waits for cooldowns left from the previous rotation.

new: KQM builds now find team setups where one member hands a set to a teammate (for example Danica taking Tenacity of the Millelith from Odette), worth up to a few percent more team DPS.

Shields now count in rotations: Angelos Heptades, Starcaller's Watch, Fractured Halo and the weapons and sets that work while shielded (The Bell, The Unforged, Summit Shaper, Memory of Dust, Vortex Vanquisher, Calamity of Eshu, Retracing Bolide) turn on while your team's shields are up, and Beacon of the Reed Sea's HP bonus while you're not shielded.
Rotation writer: write CA[beams=2] to choose how many beams Sandrone fires in a Charged Attack (up to 3, or 6 from C1).
fixed: Fischl's Skill summons a new Oz whenever it is ready, even while Oz is still out (after a Sacrificial reset, or with her Burst's Oz up); it only calls Oz back while on cooldown. Fischl teams were counted up to 16% low.
Bloom, Hyperbloom and Burgeon deal damage at most twice every 0.5 s per character, as in the game; Hyperbloom teams were counted too high.
Alhaitham's Projection Attacks follow their in-game cooldown (his hitlag lengthens it), so they no longer use up the Electro and Hydro that Lunar-Charged needs.
Sandrone releases her Charged Attack right after her last beam, so her rotations are about 1 s shorter and her DPS is higher.
Zhongli's stele now resonates with Lunar-Crystallize's Moondrifts, recasting Albedo's, Ningguang's or Itto's construct no longer counts it twice, and Chiori's A4 triggers on every construct created.
Rainbow Serpent's Rainbow, Tidal Shadow and Song of Stillness now turn on when the rotation triggers them.
Freminet's Pressure Level now builds correctly when a Normal Attack string starts just before his Burst's Stalking ends.
With two non-Moonsign members, Ascendant Gleam now comes from the latest one to use a Skill or Burst.
A team's only Hexerei member now gets its Witch's Homework bonuses (for example A Day Carved From Rising Winds' CRIT Rate); Secret Rite effects still need two Hexerei.

new: The ER calculator counts every energy weapon from its game text (Lumidouce Elegy, Dialogues of the Desert Sages, Tome of the Eternal Flow, Frostbreath and more), each at most once per its cooldown.
The ER calculator counts The Exile's 4-piece: 6 Energy to each other member per Burst of the wearer.
The rotation writer shows the time per rotation as Team Optimize and KQM count it, and when a rotation has to wait for a cooldown, how long it takes without waiting and what it waits for.
The KQM tab's timeline shows the weapon and set buffs of the builds shown, each named by its weapon or set.
The timeline fits a phone in landscape: the detailed view opens full screen and the writer is one column.
The weapon chooser in Team optimize has a None button: untick everything, then tick just the weapons you want.
fixed: Heart of the Furnace's 4-piece now needs the wearer's own Stellar Glimmer hits or reactions and lasts 12 s; it was counted all rotation whenever anyone in the team made Stellar reactions.
Instructor's 4-piece now needs the wearer to trigger the reaction while on the field.
Shimenawa's Reminiscence lasts 10 s after the wearer's Skill on the field; it was counted all rotation.
Gilded Dreams' 4-piece now counts in KQM, for 8 s after the wearer's own reactions (once every 8 s); KQM always had it off.
Disenchantment in Deep Shadow's CRIT Rate now counts while Superconduct or the Polestar field is on the enemy; it never counted.
Finale of the Deep Galleries counts only for characters without Energy (Skirk, Mavuika), and its two halves lock each other out for 6 s; it was counted for everyone.
Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City: Spread counts as Dendro only, and Hyperbloom and Burgeon now trigger it.
A Day Carved From Rising Winds needs the wearer's own Normal, Charged, Skill or Burst hits and lasts 6 s; it was on for everyone.
Crimson Witch of Flames: each Skill refreshes all its stacks, as in the game.
Deepwood Memories is triggered by the wearer's Skill and Burst hits of any element, not by Dendro hits.
Nymph's Dream counts one stack per kind of attack the wearer landed on the field in the last 8 s; it was counted at 3 stacks.
Long Night's Oath stacks come from the wearer's Plunging, Charged and Skill hits on the field, 6 s each, up to 5.
Legacy of the First Chronicle gives one Starspark per Normal Attack; it was counted twice.
Martial Artist lasts 8 s after the Skill and Maiden Beloved 10 s after the Skill or Burst; they were counted all rotation.
Lavawalker, Thundersoother and Blizzard Strayer count hit by hit from the enemy's element at that hit, KQM's candidate sets too.
A set's switch turned on by hand no longer keeps its effect on all rotation when the rotation never triggers it (for example, Viridescent Venerer's shred of an element nobody swirls).

Without a written rotation: Aubade of Morningstar and Moon counts for members that make no Normal or Charged Attacks, Husk of Opulent Dreams only for Geo characters, and Berserker, Brave Heart and Tiny Miracle are off.
Team Optimize counts a rotation's real pace: a rotation that uses a skill faster than its cooldown allows was counted at its first, fastest time.
KQM: a character you set to use their Burst every 2nd or 3rd rotation in the ER calculator now does so in the played rotation, instead of waiting for it every time.
The rotation text now understands character names in your language (Russian, Chinese and so on), and a rotation written without arrows between characters is read correctly.
The timeline no longer disappears behind the hit cards on a laptop screen at 100% zoom.

new: Your data now live in the browser's database (IndexedDB) instead of local storage, so the 5 MB storage limit is gone. Everything moves over by itself on your first visit, and every entry is checked before the old copy is removed.
Saving happens in the background and no longer stalls the page. If a save ever fails, a notice says so and leaving the page asks first.
Saved KQM results take about a fifth of the space they did.
The rotation writer's hit cards show each attack in its own colour, as the rotation panel does.
fixed: Sandrone's Stellar-Swirl charged beam used the Stellar-Conduct multiplier; it now uses its own, higher one.
Exaiphanes Blade's ATK bonus at R4 and R5 is 32% and 40%, as in the game.
DEF reduction is capped at 90%, as in the game.
Team buffs from elemental resonance and reactions say so in their tooltip, instead of naming the active character.
Theorycraft: when no substat distribution meets your stat filters, your substats are kept and a warning says so; they used to be overwritten.
Optimize: a target that adds up to nothing (for example, its talent conditional is off) can't be started, and the button's tooltip says why.
Team import: errors show in the import dialog, and pasting a character's multi-target setup tells you where to import it.

new: Rotation writer: point at any moment of the timeline to read it (who is on the field, the enemy's aura, stacks, the hit there and its damage), and click to pin it. "Detailed timeline" opens a large window with the enemy's aura, every stack and resource over time, each member's buffs, the damage as it adds up, and a card for each member showing their stats, stacks and buffs at that moment.
The Teams page is redesigned: each member is a game-style card with their weapon, artifact sets and main stats, hover any of them for details, and every team shows its elemental resonance.

KQM Theorycrafting: Instructor and The Exile can be chosen, counted by KQM Standards for 4★ artifacts (lower main stats, 0.8 of the substats and 2 fewer distributed rolls for each 4★ piece, one 5★ off-piece).
KQM Theorycrafting: each weapon group's refinement (R1 to R5) is chosen right in the setup.
improved: Rotation writer: each member's hits are cards with every attack's share, and the notes fold behind one line.
fixed: KQM Theorycrafting: the rotation preview and timeline on the KQM tab play at the constellations set in KQM Setup, not your own.
Heretic's Molten Blade counts only after its wielder's Elemental Skill while they are on the field, not for every hit.

new: KQM Theorycrafting: the attacks of the rotation played for the builds open to show each buff up during the attack, what it gives and how much it adds, and the hit's stats, all for the builds shown. Picking other equipment in the results updates the rotation's attacks and damage.
fixed: Moonpiercer's ATK counts only when its wielder triggers Dendro reactions itself, as for Sapwood Blade and Forest Regalia, so it no longer ranks first in teams without Dendro.

KQM Theorycrafting: a weapon that changes a teammate's Energy Recharge requirement (Favonius) is scored with that teammate's artifacts built again, so the Energy Recharge it frees turns into damage, and picking another weapon never leaves a teammate short of its Energy Recharge.
KQM Theorycrafting: an attack opened before a run, or with an older run, no longer shows its buffs loading forever.

improved: KQM Theorycrafting: the setup has a Weapons and artifact sets section. Battle Pass, 4★ event wish, 5★ standard wish and 5★ event wish weapons switch on and off right there, each showing the refinement it counts at; Choose weapons and Choose sets pick them one by one.
fixed: The Widsith counts the average of its three songs, for 10 s each time its wielder takes the field (once per 30 s), instead of always its ATK song. Its passive also has an "Average of the three" option.

Rotation writer: tapping Mitya's Skill again to switch his Detection Core between modes no longer detonates his Gradient Beacons, so his next Charged Attack in Overload is a Gradient Detonation that spends them. As in game, only a Steady core detonates them: when it ends, or when his Skill is tapped or held anew after its cooldown.

new: KQM Theorycrafting: Top teams, under the member inspector: the best team, then the best teams that change one member's weapon or artifact sets, each with its team DPS and how far it is from the best. The member that changes stands out; pick a team to see it. The top 50 open in a window.

Rotation writer: a wait while Mualani surfs in Nightsoul's Blessing builds Wave Momentum, as walking does in game, so "E W90f N1" plays a Surging Bite. Waits can now be written in frames: W90f is 90 frames.
KQM Theorycrafting: member cards show the weapon and artifact sets of each build, and the constellation as a badge.
improved: KQM Theorycrafting generates builds about 4 times faster, with the same results.
fixed: KQM Theorycrafting now counts what a set or weapon does in the rotation before it is picked, so sets like Viridescent Venerer are chosen when their effect helps the team (Stellar Swirl teams no longer stay on Blizzard Strayer).
KQM Theorycrafting: picking another weapon or set in a result plays the rotation again with it, so the buffs and debuffs it gives the team are counted.
KQM Theorycrafting gives a weapon the game has one copy of (Exaiphanes' Blade and other quest rewards) to one member at most.
Rotation writer: Mualani's surfing jumps, dashes and bites no longer delay her next Skill, so every rotation plays its Surging Bites.
Epochal Advent's 4-piece bonus counts while the wearer is off the field again.

new: KQM Theorycrafting: picking another weapon or set now updates the team DPS and every member card, and picks for several members add up.
KQM Theorycrafting: each member card shows how many rolls went to each substat (hover for fixed, added and total); the same line sits next to Artifact totals.
Rotation timeline: each swap now shows as its own block before the next member's actions.

Frame data: actions that change in a mode or stance (Zibai's Spirit Steed's Stride, Wanderer's Windfavored attacks, Raiden's Musou Isshin and more) have their own rows, so editing one no longer changes the other.

KQM Theorycrafting (Beta): a new tab on every team. It builds each member from KQM-standard artifacts and the weapons you allow, for the team's rotation, and ranks the sets and weapons for each member. Runs keep going in the background, and the last result is still there after a reload.
Team Optimize: write a rotation as text, like “Odette EE -> Mitya E -> Sandrone Q”. It is played out with each character's frame data: cooldowns, energy, reactions and when buffs are up.
Team Optimize has a cleaner look, with details in tooltips, and “What raises team damage” now stays with the saved result.
fixed: Every character released or buffed since 5.0 now follows the game text at every constellation.
Many older characters' buffs and constellations now follow the game text too.

new: Team Optimize: exclude artifacts from a team's optimization. Press ⊘ on an artifact in a result, or find artifacts by set, slot and main stat under Optimize team → Excluded artifacts, where each can be used again.

fixed: Optimize and Team Optimize keep running at full speed when the tab is in the background or the window is minimised.
Anastasya: her C2 and C6 bonuses now show their Stellar Swirl lines too (the damage already counted them).

improved: Danica and the Tsaritsa follow the latest beta data: the Tsaritsa's Palestar Crown and her burst's Stellar Glimmer bonus are lower.
The upcoming artifact sets have their official names, Epochal Advent and Empyrean Sojourn.
fixed: Epochal Advent's 4-piece bonus only counts while the wearer is on the field, as in the latest beta.

title: Build cards
new: Build card: a picture of a character's build to download or copy, from the character page or a team member's page. It shows the character's art, constellation, talents, weapon, artifacts with their Roll Value and Crit Value, the artifacts' totals and the character's own stats.
Choose which substats count toward a character's Roll Value on its build card; the others are dimmed.
Team card in Team Optimize results: the team's DPS and rotation, then every member's build card with its share of the damage, in one picture.

title: The first Stellar Optimizer release
new: Team Optimize: optimize the whole team's artifacts and weapons for one rotation, with energy weapons, member swaps, the closest build when a requirement can't be met, and the next best team builds.
Improve tab (formerly the Artifact Upgrader), with a built-in substat value and a what-to-farm strip.
One-click theorycraft of any build, with its best roll distribution.
Mitya and Valeriy, with their weapons, from beta data ahead of their release.
The unreleased characters Danica and Anastasya, with the upcoming weapons and artifact sets.
A best-build page for every character, and an FAQ.
This changelog, links to the source on GitHub and a Buy me a coffee link.
improved: A much faster artifact optimizer: a new search engine, sped up with WebGPU where the browser supports it.
A new look: dark theme, compact navigation, a home dashboard, and redesigned Optimize tab, filters and character cards.
Pages answer clicks at once, art loads as WebP, and the site always runs its latest version.
Official Chinese terms, and stat names that can be translated.
No ads; privacy-friendly analytics without cookies.
fixed: Team Optimize keeps each member to its allowed sets: a member takes the pieces its sets need from a teammate, or the run tells you who can't fit.
Team Optimize no longer keeps a weapon left out of "Weapons to choose from" when a ticked one was free.
